url.ask: OPC UA endpoint of Flow Commander's OPC UA server on the Flow Commander PC
url.help: Enable the OPC UA server in Flow Commander (an optional feature; Vapourtec supplies it with Python examples). The port is not published; 4840 is the OPC UA default and a placeholder.

username.ask: OPC UA user name, if the server requires one (Enter for anonymous)

max_pressure_bar.ask: Pressure (bar) above which a run is stopped by this package
max_pressure_bar.help: Below the weakest part of the flow path (glass coils, the BPR cartridge, the pumps' own limit of 42 bar on an R2/R2+).

nodes.ask: Node ids (edit config.json after browsing the server; see references/opcua_nodes.md)
